scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web" -c "blue,green"
scripts.db:sync: npx prisma db push --schema=./packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run generate -w packages/database && npm run build -w packages/database
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json packages/database/dist apps/*/node_modules && npm install
